description: Defines the EmpDependent entity class for ORM mapping, representing a dependent of an employee within the HRM system, including properties like name, relationship, and date of birth.

classes.name: EmpDependent
classes.description: Entity class representing a dependent of an employee, mapped to 'hs_hr_emp_dependents' table with properties for personal and relationship details.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this dependent.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this dependent.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the dependent.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the dependent.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dependent.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the dependent.

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the type of relationship, validating the value.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns the date of birth of the dependent.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the date of birth of the dependent.
